bias.en: Rebound failed · MACD crossed back down, near the SAR
bias.zh: 反弹失败 · MACD 再度下穿，接近 SAR

read.en: ASML fell 5.9% on Nov 16 to $1,406.79, trading $1,404.06–1,446.36. It is below the 5-day ($1,488.3), 10-day ($1,478.4), 30-day ($1,604.5), 100-day ($1,702.9) and 200-day ($1,602.1). MACD crossed back below its signal on Nov 16, a session after crossing up, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($1,382.45), and RSI is 36.2.

The drop broke the 10-day and the $1,443.5–1,490 supports, plus the Nov 6 low ($1,409.21), all now resistance; the close is 1.8% above the SAR. Resistance is $1,409–1,425, then $1,443.5–1,447.5 (Nov 5, 6 and 16 highs) and $1,478–1,488 (10 and 5-day). Support is $1,382.5 (SAR), then $1,355–1,357 (Nov 5 low and close). A close above $1,447.5 would target $1,478; below $1,382.5, the SAR would flip bearish.
